title: Moose (post-DR migrations)
description: MooseStack pinned to a release containing the delta-based migrations ("DR") work: timestamped delta files, parent_state_hash validation, applied_migrations log, moose migrate --validate, and structured partial-failure forensics. The scenario's per-harness seed enables migrate_with_deltas in moose.config.toml.
installScript: bash -i <(curl -fsSL https://fiveonefour.com/install.sh) 514@0.64.0 && ln -sf "$HOME/.local/bin/514" /usr/local/bin/514 && bash -i <(curl -fsSL https://fiveonefour.com/install.sh) moose@0.6.520 && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.moose/bin:$PATH" && ln -sf "$HOME/.moose/bin/moose" /usr/local/bin/moose && mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude/skills" && if 514 agent init --agent claude-code --yes; then true; else node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const home=process.env.HOME; const configPath=`${home}/.claude.json`; fs.mkdirSync(`${home}/.claude/skills`, { recursive: true }); let root={}; try { root=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(configPath, "utf8")); } catch (error) { root={}; } root.mcpServers={...(root.mcpServers||{}), "moose-dev": { type: "http", url: "http://localhost:4000/mcp" }, "context7": { type: "http", url: "https://mcp.context7.com/mcp" }}; fs.writeFileSync(configPath, `${JSON.stringify(root, null, 2)}\n`);'; fi && mkdir -p /opt/dec-bench/moose && cd /opt/dec-bench/moose && npm init -y && npm install @514labs/moose-lib@0.6.520
